meaning: Estimated probability that this business becomes a paying client after one personal outreach sequence (call or one-to-one WhatsApp + follow-up). Logistic model: log-odds = intercept + sum(weight * signal), with grouped signals capped.
intercept_note: logit(1.5%). Cold outreach to unfiltered local businesses closes ~0.2-2% (Belkins, Martal, Hunter benchmarks). See RESEARCH.md.

opportunity.note: Website/automation gaps are correlated; capping stops a broken site from stacking past roughly 'no website at all' plus a bit.

no_website.note: No site at all: the strongest website-sale signal in every agency scorer; no-website call campaigns report ~12% discovery-call rate.

site_dead.note: Listed site is down / times out / returns an error. Scorers weight dead sites highest among site issues.

ssl_error.note: Browser shows a security warning to visitors.

no_https.note: Plain http: 'Not secure' label in Chrome.

no_mobile.note: No mobile viewport: the page is not mobile-friendly.

stale_site.note: Copyright year is 3+ years old: likely abandoned or outdated.

slow_site.note: First response took more than 4 seconds.

no_booking_or_whatsapp.note: Working site but no online booking and no WhatsApp link: the automation pitch. WhatsApp is the default business channel in Israel.

no_contact_capture.note: No form, no click-to-call, no WhatsApp, no chat widget: leads are leaking.

has_phone.note: Reachable by phone/WhatsApp, the channels that convert best for local businesses.

has_social.note: Active Facebook/Instagram page: the business is alive and markets itself.

has_hours.note: Opening hours are mapped: an active business.

high_value_cat.note: Clinics, dentists, beauty, lawyers, trades, restaurants, fitness, hotels: higher ticket and bookings-driven; reported as best converting.

low_value_cat.note: Kiosks, convenience stores, tobacco etc.: little budget and little need.

modern_complete.note: Already has a modern HTTPS mobile site with booking/WhatsApp/chat: little to sell.

no_contact.note: No phone, email, social or website found: cannot be reached personally.
